# Actor Benchmark

The Apify actor [`apify/actor-benchmark`](https://apify.com/apify/actor-benchmark) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.8**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Compares various builds of the same actor to measure how they perform on the same input

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/actor-benchmark) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-actor-benchmark@0.0.8#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      buildNumbers: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `buildNumbers` | array | yes |  | Build numbers or tags — List of build numbers or tags to benchmark. Each entry will receive an identical run in parallel. You can use exact version numbers (e.g. "0.3.67") or tags (e.g. "canary"), which will use the latest build associated with that tag. |
| `runsPerBuild` | integer |  | `3` | Runs per build — Number of times each build is run. Results are averaged to reduce the effect of outliers. All runs are started in parallel on your account, so make sure you have enough memory quota available to allow them all to start simultaneously. |
| `actorId` | string |  |  | Actor ID — The ID or name of the Apify actor to benchmark (e.g. "apify/website-content-crawler"). |
| `actorInput` | object |  |  | Actor input — The JSON input passed to every run of the benchmarked actor. |
| `taskId` | string |  |  | Task ID — The ID or name of an Apify task to benchmark (e.g. "my-username/my-task"). |
| `maxRunDurationSecs` | integer |  |  | Max run duration (seconds) — Timeout in seconds for each actor run. Runs exceeding this limit will be aborted. |
| `memoryMbytes` | integer |  |  | Memory (MB) — Memory in megabytes allocated to each actor run. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
